facts: Approximately 160 feet north to south by 140 east to west. Cross-shaped plan, Doric porticoes, octagonal dome base, circular tiered plinths and anthemion crown.

record: North Carolina State Historic Sites construction history
facts: A domed cross-shaped building with Doric exterior columns and Greek-derived honeysuckle ornament.
Copper on the roof and dome was replaced in 2023–24.
